text: The whey is heated slowly to 65 °C, the milk goes in, and heating goes on under stirring. At 80–85 °C small crumbly curds appear. They are skimmed off with a slotted spoon, drained and cut in blocks. No starter and no rennet are used, only heat.

steps.note: The milk is added when the whey is at about 65 °C.
The dried kind is ripened, and not the fresh, until it is too hard to cut.

processing.text: Only the dried kind is matured: gently heated or sun-dried and matured until too hard to cut. No time given.
